scenes.say: Picture this. A storm is coming, and you want backup power.
Should you get a portable power station, or a home battery?
Portable power stations hold about one to five kilowatt-hours. Perfect for a fridge, lights, and devices.
Home batteries hold ten to fifteen or more, and back up whole circuits automatically.
A portable unit with foldable panels can cost under three thousand dollars. An installed home battery usually costs ten thousand or more.
Safety tip: never backfeed a portable unit into your house wiring without a proper transfer switch.
Planning for outages? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
